output.summary: KEP-617 proposes a set of small, incremental process, documentation, visibility, and automation changes to make Kubernetes KEPs easier to find, navigate, and consume. Its status is provisional.
output.rationale: KEP artifacts were hard to navigate, and it was hard to tell which KEPs were in which states and what remained undecided. A sig-arch KEP reading group found it difficult to track KEP activity. The proposal therefore bundles several small improvements rather than one large change.

alternatives.option: Leave unresolved text out or HTML-commented
alternatives.why_not: The authors feel it is more useful to actually show that text and emphasize its non-resolvedness.
Renaming without subdirectories incurs most of the same pain with less gain.
It was already tried and gave way to the current date mechanism.
Not fixing tooling would incur more of the same pain the project suffers today.

evidence.quote: Drive KEP adoption through improved process, documentation, visibility, and automation.
It's hard to find which KEPs are in which states and to know what is considered undecided.
This proposal aims to define several small, incremental steps that can be taken to make these problems a bit better.
Leaving unresolved text out completely or HTML-commented could work, but we feel it is more useful to actually show that text and emphasize its non-resolvedness.
